# What's the new car loan interest deduction worth?

> Free calculator for the new federal auto loan interest deduction (One Big Beautiful Bill Act, tax years 2025-2028): applies the $10,000 cap, the $200-per-$1,000 MAGI phase-out, and the 8-item new/US-assembled/personal-use/first-lien eligibility checklist -- including the MFS treatment most people get wrong.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
